items.title: Support / Donate
items.body: A new Settings entry to support FloatNative's development.

items.title: Sleep Timer
items.body: Pause playback automatically after a chosen duration. Settings → Playback.

items.title: Force Landscape
items.body: Lock to landscape from the player with a single tap, even when system auto-rotate is off.

items.title: Playback Speed Sticks
items.body: Your chosen playback speed now carries from one video to the next.

items.title: Android TV / Fire TV Stays Awake
items.body: The screen no longer dims during playback.

items.title: Sideloaded APK Icon
items.body: Standalone APK builds now show the FloatNative icon instead of the default Android robot.
